purpose: Answer the highest-priority shared objections from three independent manuscript reviewers with a compact causal and strong-baseline experiment, while preserving the user's three-restart no-continuation rule.

prelaunch_audit_resolution.timing: prospective amendment made before any scientific cell was launched
resolved_blockers: add a same-initial-state KnownProjector_HD control so learned projector reference is not confounded with initialization, phase, loss, depth, optimizer, or parameter count
make Stage1Only resource accounting and health treatment explicit
make the optimizer-budget audit determine the new campaign budget and require depth reselection before validation when the budget changes
lock all optimizer records before deriving or evaluating target identities
apply claim rules separately to each comparison and each N
retire external-validation seed 840025101 after a prelaunch unit test derived its target and replace it prospectively with untouched seed 840025111

seed_rotation.reason: strict held-out blindness after prelaunch test-only target derivation

evidence_boundary.new_campaign_role: prospective appendix evidence on fresh objective seeds
evidence_boundary.no_posthoc_target_switch: best2 remains primary; ground and best8 are secondary diagnostics
evidence_boundary.claim_scope: size-specific best2 post-training logical sampling cost on this BCST setting under the frozen optimizer, depth, and resource protocol; no scaling, hardware-advantage, cross-family, or universal Grover-mixer claim

fixed_problem.objective_training_rule: expected energy of the method-specific phase Hamiltonian; target identities are never optimizer inputs

randomness.initializer_distribution: each scalar independently Uniform[-pi,pi] from a SHA-256 counter KDF
randomness.budget_pairing_rule: the optimizer budget is excluded from the initializer KDF domain so 400, 800, and 1600 runs within a method-size-seed-restart cell have byte-identical checkpoint-zero parameters while resetting Adam state
randomness.disjointness_rule: all listed seeds and KDF phase/method domains must be pairwise distinct and must not occur in predecessor artifacts

stage1.maximum_steps: the prospectively adopted Stage-1 budget selected by the budget_audit rules
stage1.selection: lowest expected H_C across exactly three independent starts
stage1.identity_requirement: LP, WarmXY, both same-state causal controls, and Stage1Only at a given N use the identical serialized Stage-1 amplitude vector

WarmXY.initial_state: same fresh frozen Stage-1 state as LP

Stage1Only.initial_state: same fresh frozen Stage-1 state as LP
Stage1Only.formal_eligibility: eligible both alone and inside the best-Stage-1-use envelope
Stage1Only.terminal_RU: P1 + O, using the same one-time Stage-1 preparation and terminal objective-verification conventions as LP
Stage1Only.stage2_health: not_applicable; require a finite normalized frozen Stage-1 state, verified amplitude hash, finite H_C, and exact resource accounting

new_strong_baseline.name: NativeGrover-d
new_strong_baseline.purpose: strong end-to-end native known-state global-projector baseline
new_strong_baseline.interpretation_limit: LP versus NativeGrover-d is an algorithm-level comparison only; it does not isolate learned-reference value because initialization, phase Hamiltonian, and parameterization also differ
new_strong_baseline.extension_rule: extend when the upper boundary is selected or is within 10 percent of the finite minimum while cost is non-increasing from the preceding boundary
new_strong_baseline.selection_rule: minimize the exact product of the two tuning-seed integer best2 logical costs; ties choose shallower depth

causal_ablation.purpose: cross mixer and phase Hamiltonian from the identical Stage-1 state so the projector effect is not confounded with H_F versus H_D

KnownProjector_HD.causal_role: relative to Projector_HD, only the projector reference changes from phi to s

planned_contrasts: Projector_HF versus XY_HF at common depth
Projector_HD versus XY_HD at common depth
Projector_HF versus Projector_HD at common depth
XY_HF versus XY_HD at common depth
Projector_HD versus KnownProjector_HD at common depth as the isolated projector-reference contrast
causal_ablation.scientific_role: mechanistic exploratory evidence; no broad causal claim is permitted beyond the explicitly matched contrast

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.exact_step_rule: every restart executes exactly the adopted number of Adam updates; an earlier iterate may remain the selected incumbent
optimizer.incumbent: lowest expected training energy among checkpoint zero and every central iterate; exact ties choose earlier checkpoint, then lower restart index

budget_audit.scientific_role: prospective budget selection for the new campaign; it cannot mutate the predecessor sealed Adam-400 result
budget_audit.seeds: the fresh Stage-1 seed at each N for Stage-1 and the two depth_and_budget_tuning seeds at each N for every Stage-2 method

audit_depths.NativeGrover-d: the provisional depth selected by its exact-400 scan

budget_audit.pairing: separate optimizer runs with reset Adam state and identical checkpoint-zero vectors; 800 never resumes 400
budget_audit.normalized_improvement: mean over the applicable frozen audit cells of (E_short-E_long)/max(Hmax-Hmin,1e-12): one cell for Stage1 and two tuning seeds for each Stage-2 method
budget_audit.terminal_progress: on each tuning seed's selected restart, selected checkpoint lies in the final 10 percent or normalized best-so-far energy drops by at least 0.01 over the final 20 percent
budget_audit.adam1600_trigger: for a method-size stratum, run an independent exact-1600 batch from the same three initial vectors if mean normalized 400-to-800 improvement is at least 0.02 or terminal_progress holds on either 800-step tuning seed
budget_audit.adoption_rule: adopt 400 only if the 400-to-800 improvement is below 0.02 and no applicable 800 audit cell has terminal_progress; otherwise run 1600, adopt 800 only if mean normalized 800-to-1600 improvement is below 0.02 and no applicable 800 audit cell has terminal_progress, adopt 1600 if no applicable 1600 audit cell has terminal_progress, and otherwise mark that method-size optimizer-inconclusive
budget_audit.stage1_regeneration_rule: if the adopted Stage1 budget is not 400, regenerate and re-freeze phi from the same three initial vectors at the adopted budget before any Stage-2 scientific cell
budget_audit.depth_reselection_rule: if an externally validated Stage-2 method-size budget changes from 400, rerun [1,2,4,8,12,16,24,36] and the same [48,64], [80,96] boundary extensions at the adopted budget before validation; if a causal-only method budget changes, rerun every frozen common-depth causal point at the adopted budget; no 400-step depth result may be retained silently
budget_audit.claim_gate: a primary comparison cell is optimizer-inconclusive if either required method-size stratum is optimizer-inconclusive; it cannot receive a strong-result label

external_validation.primary_metric: integer RTS99 times terminal_RU for best2

required: selected energy no worse than checkpoint zero
selected energy no worse than the separate zero-angle diagnostic within 1e-9
health_policy.not_a_health_gate: low best2 probability is an outcome, not by itself proof of failed optimization
reported_diagnostics: best2, ground, best8, and feasible mass at those profile checkpoints where available

external_validation.cohort_lock: before any target identity or target probability is computed, atomically freeze and hash a target-blind manifest containing every expected seed, method, adopted budget, frozen depth, three restart hashes, selected checkpoint/state hash, energy, gradient norm, and resource record; target evaluation is read-only after this lock
external_validation.strong_result_rule: apply separately to each named primary comparison at each N: geometric-mean comparator/LP ratio at least 1.25, paired-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound above 1, and LP wins at least 8 of 10 paired instances; no global conjunction and no pooling across N
external_validation.bootstrap: 100000 deterministic paired seed-level resamples, seed 20260731; never treat depths or restarts as independent instances
external_validation.negative_policy: report negative, null, or optimizer-inconclusive outcomes without changing methods, target, depth, cohort, or thresholds

analysis_only_additions.claim_evidence_crosswalk: separate historical SPSA, sealed Adam400, Adam800 diagnostic, new causal ablation, and new external validation

resource_break_even.output: paired ratio surfaces and the parameter boundary at which the bootstrap lower confidence limit crosses one

analysis_only_additions.depth_resource_pareto: plot success and logical cost against depth and terminal_RU, marking transferred/selected depths and causal-grid points
analysis_only_additions.paired_forest: show every external-validation seed ratio and do not pool repeated depths

execution.parallelism: up to four independent cells concurrently; the three restarts inside each cell remain sequential
launch_order: 400 versus 800 budget audit and conditional 1600 branch for Stage-1 and all named Stage-2 methods
budget adoption and any mandatory depth reselection
external validation and causal ablation in parallel
post-lock target evaluation, analysis, independent result audit, and appendix package
